units: <cite ref="Shabbat 62b:23">Sabb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>אנשי … אנשי ש׳ היו</he> the men of Jerusalem were lovers of obscene talk; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 264">Yalk. Is. 264</cite> <he>שחוצים</he>).

Pes. 3ᵇ ש׳ פסול (they found in him) obscenity which made him unworthy of the priesthood; (Rashi: pride). Tanḥ. Vaëra 9; Ex. R. s. 8 לך ועשה מי שעשה עצמו אלוה ש׳ בעולם go and make him that made himself a god an abomination in the world; ib. וכן … נעשה ש׳ בעולם and so Sennacherib prided himself, and became an abomination &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 8:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אני ממלא … ומראה שַׁהֲצוֹ לבריות</he> I fill the upper and the lower regions with him (his repute), and let people see his disgrace; Tanḥ. l. c. <he>שבחן</he> (corr. acc.). Ib. <he>הקב״ה מראה ש׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord shows all men the disgrace of the proud; a. e.—Pl. <he>שְׁחָצִים</he>. Ib. (ref. to <cite ref="Job 41:26">Job XLI, 26</cite> <he>בני שחץ</he>) <he>אלו הגיותנין … ש׳ בעולם</he> this means the proud that make themselves gods: the Lord makes them abominations in the world.
